question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Precocious
solution:
The correct answer is '**Backward**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Precocious**' is '**Backward**'.
 
• **Precocious**: (used about children) having developed certain abilities and ways of behaving at a much younger age than usual. [(बच्‍चा) सामान्‍य से कम आयु में (अपने से बड़ों की) योग्‍यताएँ विकसित कर लेने वाला; छोटी आयु में बड़ों जैसा आचरण करने वाला; अकालपक्‍व, पूर्वविकसित]
 
 
• *Example: a **precocious** child who started her acting career at the age of 5...*
 
 
 
• **Backward**: slow to develop or learn. (विकसित होने या सीखने में पीछे; मन्द; पिछड़ा)
 
 
• *Example: Our teaching methods are **backward** compared to some countries.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Backward.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__

• **Gentle**: (used about people) kind and calm; touching or treating people or things in a careful way so that they are not hurt. [(व्‍यक्ति) दयालु और शांत; बिना चोट पहुँचाए कोमलता से व्‍यवहार करने वाला; सौम्‍य]
 
• **Lenient**: (used about a punishment or person who punishes) not as strict as expected. [(दंड या दंड देने वाला व्‍यक्ति) जो आशा के अनुरूप कठोर न हो; नरम, सौम्‍य]
